text:
maya: Heads up eu-west-1 GPU fleet — after last night's OFED/kernel roll we started seeing inter-node NCCL bandwidth drop and some training pods falling back to TCP.

raj: seeing the same. Jobs report lots of NCCL WARN CONNECT and long allreduce times.

lina: quick data point — `iperf3` between two p3 nodes shows ~20% of expected throughput.

maya: exact error from one job log: `NCCL WARN NET/IB :1195 : recv connect failed - connection timed out` then `NCCL INFO AllReduce done, 120ms` (used to be ~20-30ms).

derek: can you paste `dmesg` or `ethtool -i`? wondering if EFA kernel module failed to load after kernel bump.

maya: pasted snippets: `ethtool -i eth0: driver: efa version: 1.12.3 firmware-version: 2.1.0` then `dmesg | tail`:
```
[  234.567890] efa 0000:03:00.0: failed to create tx cq
[  234.567891] efa 0000:03:00.0: qp create failed: -107
[  234.567892] efa: probe of 0000:03:00.0 failed with error -107
```

raj: -107 is EFAULT? Could be ABI mismatch between efa kernel module and new kernel. Which kernel version rolled?

maya: kernel 6.2.17 -> 6.3.0-rc1 (we pulled the vendor edge image). OFED package upgraded from `mlnx-ofed-5.4.2` to `mlnx-ofed-5.5.0`.

lina: that explains it — EFA kernel module is very picky about kernel/OFED combos. If QP/CQ can't be created, NCCL will fallback to IB or tcp depending on transport, hurting bandwidth.

infra-oncall: flagging as Sev-2 for GPU fleet impact. Rolling back non-critical nodes now. Need decision on full rollback or targeted.

maya: suggested plan: roll nodes with the new kernel/O FED back to previous AMI (6.2.17 + ofed-5.4.2) for eu-west-1 gpu pool, block further autobakes, and submit ticket to vendor with the dmesg + ethtool.

derek: +1. We should also add a quick health-check job that runs `nccl-tests` allreduce on 8 GPUs across two nodes after any infra upgrade.

m aya: (typo) maya: agreed — add that to the rollout checklist. Also posting the `nccl-tests` output: `all_reduce: 1/1 coll time 0.118s` on bad nodes, `0.022s` on good nodes.

raj: temporary mitigation: we can force NCCL to prefer `NET/SHM` where possible by setting `NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME` and `NCCL_IB_DISABLE=1`, but that's just a stopgap and hurts cross-node perf.

sre-bot: Deploy job #4521 kicked off revert for eu-west-1-gpu-pool -> rolling nodegroup-3 (2/15 done). :gear:
